title: Pointed evaluation lands in the relative separable closure
statement: Let Y be a scheme, barY: Spec Ω → Y an algebraically closed geometric point, and give Ω the residue-field algebra structure specified by barY (hΩ). For every a in the chosen coordinate-ring colimit C [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], its canonical pointed evaluation [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-point-evaluation] in Ω belongs to the relative separable closure of the residue field of the image of barY [def-weil-pbc-relative-separable-closure]. No local-ring hypothesis on C is required.

proof.text: Use strictHenselization_properties to obtain cofilteredness of the small representative category. The forgetful functor on commutative rings preserves its filtered colimits. Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep represents any element by a global section b on one affine pointed étale neighbourhood.

Apply strictHenselizationPointEvaluation_pointed. Naturality of Γ and Spec identifies Spec of evaluation on sections with the neighbourhood point. Cancel isoSpec.inv and use faithfulness of Spec to identify evaluation on the colimit coprojection with evaluation of b at that point.

Factor the neighbourhood point through its residue field. The source-library theorem Hom.etale_residueFieldMap makes its residue-field extension étale, hence separable by Algebra.FormallyEtale.iff_isSeparable. The point induces an algebra homomorphism to Ω, so IsSeparable.map makes the evaluated section separable. SpecToEquivOfField_eq_iff applied to the pointed triangle and hΩ identifies the transported base algebra map. Transport separability across residueFieldCongr and conclude by mem_separableClosure_iff.

proof_origin.place: Tags 04HX and 04GW; filtered-colimit representatives and étale residue-field separability
proof_origin.note: F1 directly proves the section-evaluation separability helper using the source library and Mathlib; no new holed statement.

lean.statement: theorem strictHenselizationPointEvaluation_mem {Y : Scheme.{v}} {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (barY : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y) [Algebra (Y.residueField (barY (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))) Ω] (hΩ : algebraMap (Y.residueField (barY (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))) Ω = (descResidueField (stalkClosedPointTo barY)).hom) (a : strictHenselizationRing barY) : strictHenselizationPointEvaluation barY a ∈ separableClosure (Y.residueField (barY (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))) Ω
